description: This file defines the SavingsAccountTransaction entity class, representing monetary transactions (deposits, withdrawals, interest, fees, etc.) against a savings account in the Apache Fineract microfinance platform. It includes various factory methods for creating different transaction types, methods for calculating balances and balance periods, and details for serialization and domain behavior.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransaction
classes.description: Entity class representing a monetary transaction within a savings account, supporting deposit, withdrawal, interest, fees, transfer, reversal, and tax-related activities, with rich methods for balance calculations and status checks.

methods.name: deposit
methods.description: Creates a deposit transaction for the specified savings account, office, payment detail, date, amount, and reference number.

methods.name: withdrawal
methods.description: Creates a withdrawal transaction for the specified savings account, office, payment detail, date, amount, and reference number.

methods.name: accrual
methods.description: Records an accrual transaction for the specified savings account, office, date, amount, and reference number.

methods.name: interestPosting
methods.description: Records an interest posting transaction.

methods.name: overdraftInterest
methods.description: Records an overdraft interest transaction.

methods.name: withdrawalFee
methods.description: Records a withdrawal fee transaction.

methods.name: annualFee
methods.description: Records an annual fee transaction.

methods.name: charge
methods.description: Charges for a specific fee or penalty.

methods.name: waiver
methods.description: Waives charges for a specific fee or penalty.

methods.name: initiateTransfer
methods.description: Creates a transaction representing the initiation of a transfer.

methods.name: approveTransfer
methods.description: Approves a transfer initiated previously.

methods.name: withdrawTransfer
methods.description: Withdraws a transfer.

methods.name: withHoldTax
methods.description: Creates a withholding tax transaction, with tax details.

methods.name: escheat
methods.description: Handles escheat (unclaimed funds) transactions.

methods.name: copyTransaction
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing transaction.

methods.name: holdAmount
methods.description: Holds an amount on the account.

methods.name: releaseAmount
methods.description: Releases a held amount.

methods.name: reversal
methods.description: Creates a reversal of a given transaction.

methods.name: toMapData
methods.description: Serializes the transaction data into a Map for external use.

methods.name: toEndOfDayBalance
methods.description: Converts the transaction to an end-of-day balance snapshot.

methods.name: toEndOfDayBalanceBoundedBy
methods.description: Converts the transaction to an end-of-day balance snapshot bounded by a date interval.

methods.name: getSavingsAccount
methods.description: Returns the associated savings account.

methods.name: getTransactionDate
methods.description: Returns the transaction date.

methods.name: isReversed
methods.description: Checks if the transaction has been reversed.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Reverses the transaction.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the transaction amount.

methods.name: getRunningBalance
methods.description: Returns the running balance after this transaction.

methods.name: getOverdraftAmount
methods.description: Returns overdraft amount associated with the transaction.

methods.name: getTypeOf
methods.description: Returns the transaction type as an integer.

methods.name: getTransactionType
methods.description: Returns the transaction type as an enum.

methods.name: getDateOf
methods.description: Returns the date of the transaction.

methods.name: getRefNo
methods.description: Returns the reference number.

methods.name: getPaymentDetail
methods.description: Returns the payment detail, if any.

methods.name: updateReleaseId
methods.description: Updates the hold release transaction ID.

methods.name: updateReason
methods.description: Updates the reason for blocking.

methods.name: getReleaseIdOfHoldAmountTransaction
methods.description: Returns the release ID of hold amount transaction.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the account's currency.

methods.name: getOfficeId
methods.description: Returns the office ID.

methods.name: getBalanceEndDate
methods.description: Returns the balance end date.

methods.name: getCumulativeBalance
methods.description: Returns the cumulative balance.

methods.name: getBalanceNumberOfDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days for the balance.

methods.name: getSubmittedOnDate
methods.description: Returns the date the transaction was submitted.

methods.name: isReversalTransaction
methods.description: Checks if the transaction is a reversal.
